purpose: Audit whether the frozen long-term Pygoscelis site roster has sufficient historical and recent optical imagery to estimate terrestrial breeding-opportunity change, without reading demographic magnitudes or outcomes.

stac.provider_rule: Use the first catalog that returns a valid STAC response for a site-epoch query; fallback is technical only and does not alter epochs, thresholds, or site eligibility.

season_filter.rationale: Prefer austral spring-summer imagery when seasonal snow and darkness are less likely to prevent exposed-ground classification.

important_limit: Scene-level cloud cover is only a discovery/support screen. A site cannot enter an ecological outcome model until local pixel-level QA for cloud, shadow, snow/ice and coastline classification is separately frozen and passed.
outputs: support counts by region and species-presence set
list of sites failing early, late, or validation support
catalog provider used for each site-epoch query
stop_rule: Do not change imagery epochs, seasonal months, cloud thresholds, or scene/year minimums after demographic outcomes are joined. Outcome data remain locked after this audit regardless of whether support is broad or narrow.
